docker_api_container_action.go.name: Container actions
docker_api_container_action.go.description: Handles start, stop, pause, restart, kill, wait and remove for a pretend container.

docker_api_container_create.go.name: Create a container
docker_api_container_create.go.description: Creates a pretend container from a Docker request, including its published ports.

docker_api_documents.go.name: Docker-style answers
docker_api_documents.go.description: Shapes container and network details exactly as Docker would show them.

docker_api_images_networks.go.name: Images and networks
docker_api_images_networks.go.description: Handles listing and pulling pretend images and creating, joining and removing networks.

docker_api_server.go.name: Docker request handler
docker_api_server.go.description: Receives every Docker request on the socket, checks its version and sends it to the right handler.

docker_api_util.go.name: Request helpers
docker_api_util.go.description: Shared helpers for answers, streamed output and Docker version numbers.

docker_api_volumes_exec.go.name: Volumes and commands
docker_api_volumes_exec.go.description: Handles pretend volumes and commands run inside a container, without faking a success.

docker_filters.go.name: Docker list filters
docker_filters.go.description: Reads the filters Docker tools send when listing things, in each format clients use.

image_match.go.name: Image name matching
image_match.go.description: Matches images by their full name and tag, never by part of a name.
